meta.title: Create an eRFX project, Technical + RFQ from an open service PR line
gaps: Verify that the selected PR line is specifically a service line rather than another open PR type.

Verify that the PR moves to In Progress with this event's number after publishing.

plan.title: Create Technical + RFQ Event from Open Service PR

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published.
Assert that PR-derived product, variant, and requested quantity cells are read-only on the RFQ sheet.
Commit the requested Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Add the two vendors named in the test case.
Publish the completed Technical + RFQ event.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published event's Settings menu to inspect the PR-specific recreate restriction.
Assert that Recreate Order is present but greyed out for an event created from a PR.
